subject.title: feat(memorySearch): Support multimodal embedding with gemini-embedding-2-preview

question: Should OpenClaw expand multimodal memory beyond opt-in extraPaths image/audio into session attachments plus PDF/video, and what consent, retention, upload, and reindexing contract should gate it?
rationale: The missing behavior is feasible in the current memory/Gemini path, but it changes how raw user media is uploaded to remote embedding providers and retained in searchable memory, which automation cannot decide safely.

options.title: Design gated media memory first
options.body: Define supported modalities, opt-in consent, retention/redaction behavior, provider limits, and reindex/migration behavior before implementation work.

options.title: Limit core to shipped subset
options.body: Keep core behavior at extraPaths image/audio and reject broader attachment/PDF/video memory until a stronger maintainer-owned need appears.

options.title: Expand extraPaths only first
options.body: Allow a narrower follow-up that adds PDF/video files under extraPaths while explicitly excluding chat-attachment retention for now.

recommendation.title: Design gated media memory first
recommendation.body: Define supported modalities, opt-in consent, retention/redaction behavior, provider limits, and reindex/migration behavior before implementation work.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision lands closest to the shipped multimodal memory subset and config/docs boundary introduced by the merged memory PR.
